notes: Starter set K9 (1 long run with no reset layer) with the upkeep card S30 and 3 S02 entries.
The entries generator and speed are multiplier groups. The entry care has the role care: its line is the care line of S30.
Each level of the generator line and of each multiplier group adds 1 to the need. Each care level multiplies the capacity.
